particles.name: Particle Systems
particles.description: Explore the emergent behavior of particle systems, from single particles to complex emitters and repellers.
particles.qfep_connection: Particles as controlled entropy â€” emission, diffusion, decay. Each particle system manages the Î» parameter: how much disorder to allow, how quickly to let structures dissolve.
learning_objectives: Implementing inheritance and polymorphism in systems

artifact_groups.rationale: Single particle and array: one particle demonstrates position/velocity/acceleration, arrays show population behavior. Dark sphere anchors the space.
Emitter architecture: single emitter, particle body, multiple emitters, and sub-emitters build the emission pipeline from source to cascade.
Particles under force: force fields push populations, single attractor pulls them. External forces shaping particle trajectories — Newton applied to swarms.
Lifetime and type: inheritance polymorphism creates particle families, particle_systems manages populations, lifetime curves control birth-to-death trajectories.
Collision and repulsion: particles that bounce off boundaries and push each other away. Campfire as capstone — fire, smoke, and embers synthesizing all particle systems into one scene.
